title: 地下水抽出處理~Groundwater pump-and-treat remediation
focus: 結合含水層捕獲、地上處理與污染反彈評估抽出處理~Evaluate pump-and-treat through aquifer capture, above-ground treatment and rebound
summary: 本課以「結合含水層捕獲、地上處理與污染反彈評估抽出處理」為主軸，依序處理地層、水頭與污染羽流、抽水井捕獲尺度、水量與污染負荷配對、孔隙體積與清理拖尾、停泵反彈與捕獲復核。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。~This course focuses on Evaluate pump-and-treat through aquifer capture, above-ground treatment and rebound, progressing through Stratigraphy, heads and contaminant plume, Extraction-well capture scale, Pairing water flow with contaminant load, Pore volumes and cleanup tailing, Shutdown rebound and capture review. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
history: 這項技術的學習脈絡由單一設備處理，逐步擴展至物質與能量收支、監測品質和生命週期比較。本課將官方方法文件作為查核入口，並以獨立編寫的假想數據練習；參考文件的年代與地區不代表其規範在所有場址適用。~The learning progression expands from individual treatment equipment to mass and energy balances, monitoring quality and lifecycle comparison. Official method documents provide verification starting points while independently authored hypothetical data support practice; a document date or jurisdiction does not establish applicability to every site.

units.title: 地層、水頭與污染羽流~Stratigraphy, heads and contaminant plume
units.mechanism: 以同一高程基準連結觀測井，先定地下水流向，再區分溶解污染與持續污染源。 水頭差除以距離給指定方向的梯度；單一剖面不能代替三維地下水流場。~Connect monitoring wells to one elevation datum, determine flow direction and distinguish dissolved contamination from continuing sources. Head difference over spacing gives a directional gradient; one section cannot replace a three-dimensional groundwater field.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：兩點水頭 h1=12.4 m、h2=11.8 m；距離 L=30 m。公式 i=(h1-h2)/L，計算得 0.02 m/m。適用邊界：同一標高基準、同一含水層及同步讀值。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Heads h1=12.4 m, h2=11.8 m; spacing L=30 m. Formula i=(h1-h2)/L gives 0.02 m/m. Applicability: Common elevation datum, same aquifer and synchronized readings.
units.verify: 針對「地層、水頭與污染羽流」，測井口標高並校正液位，將多井等水頭線與地層圖共同判讀。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Stratigraphy, heads and contaminant plume, Survey reference elevations, correct water levels and interpret multiwell contours with stratigraphy. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 不同濾管深度或時間的液位可能產生假的水平梯度。 在「地層、水頭與污染羽流」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Different screen depths or measurement times can create a false horizontal gradient. Mark where this error can enter the Stratigraphy, heads and contaminant plume flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 任意兩口井的液位差都代表同一含水層的水平流向。~Any two well levels define horizontal flow in the same aquifer.
units.practice: 只將 h1 改成 12.7 m，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.02 變成 0.03 m/m。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only h1 to 12.7 m, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.02 to 0.03 m/m. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 地下水孔隙流速~Groundwater pore velocity
units.mechanism: 將水力傳導係數、梯度與有效孔隙率逐項測定，避免把地層孔隙率直接等同可移動孔隙率。 孔隙平均流速為 Darcy 通量除有效孔隙率；污染遲滯與彌散另需處理。~Determine conductivity, gradient and effective porosity separately rather than equating total with mobile porosity. Mean pore-water velocity is Darcy flux divided by effective porosity; retardation and dispersion require separate treatment.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：K=1e-4 m/s；水力梯度 i=0.01；有效孔隙率 ne=0.25。公式 v=K*i/ne*86400，計算得 0.3456 m/d。適用邊界：飽和均質含水層、層流，非裂隙運移預測。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: K=1e-4 m/s; hydraulic gradient i=0.01; effective porosity ne=0.25. Formula v=K*i/ne*86400 gives 0.3456 m/d. Applicability: Saturated homogeneous aquifer and laminar flow; not a fractured-flow prediction.
units.verify: 針對「地下水孔隙流速」，將估算流速與示蹤到達、地層和水頭場比較，列出各參數範圍。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Groundwater pore velocity, Compare estimated velocity with tracer arrival, stratigraphy and heads, listing parameter ranges. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 把 Darcy 通量直接當孔隙流速會低估移動速度。 在「地下水孔隙流速」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Using Darcy flux directly as pore velocity understates travel speed. Mark where this error can enter the Groundwater pore velocity flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 地下水孔隙流速永遠等於水力傳導係數 K。~Pore-water velocity always equals hydraulic conductivity K.
units.practice: 只將 ne 改成 0.20，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.3456 變成 0.432 m/d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only ne to 0.20, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.3456 to 0.432 m/d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 抽水井捕獲尺度~Extraction-well capture scale
units.mechanism: 用理想截流寬度當概念起點，將污染羽流邊界疊圖，再檢查地層與補注是否破壞假設。 均勻遠場的截流寬度由抽水量與天然通量平衡估計，降深範圍與污染捕獲範圍並不相同。~Start with ideal capture width, overlay plume boundaries and check whether stratigraphy or recharge invalidates assumptions. Far-field capture width follows pumping balanced against natural flux; a drawdown zone is not the same as a contamination capture zone.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：抽水 Q=100 m³/d；K=10 m/d；含水層厚 b=10 m；遠場梯度 i=0.01。公式 W=Q/(K*b*i)，計算得 100 m。適用邊界：理想穩態、均質等向性、完全貫穿單井與均勻流；僅概念尺度，非井位設計。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Pumping Q=100 m³/d; K=10 m/d; aquifer thickness b=10 m; far-field gradient i=0.01. Formula W=Q/(K*b*i) gives 100 m. Applicability: Ideal steady homogeneous isotropic aquifer, fully penetrating single well and uniform flow; a conceptual scale, not well-placement design.
units.verify: 針對「抽水井捕獲尺度」，用上、下游和側向觀測井水頭、化學趨勢與流線模型交叉驗證。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Extraction-well capture scale, Cross-check upgradient, downgradient and lateral heads, chemistry and flow-path models. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 補注邊界、部分貫穿或異質層可使理想捕獲寬度失準。 在「抽水井捕獲尺度」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Recharge boundaries, partial penetration and heterogeneity can invalidate ideal capture width. Mark where this error can enter the Extraction-well capture scale flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 井旁水位下降就證明整個污染羽流已受控制。~Water-level decline beside a well proves the entire plume is contained.
units.practice: 只將 i 改成 0.02，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 100 變成 50 m。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only gradient i to 0.02, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 100 to 50 m. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 抽水揚程與地上管線~Pumping head and surface pipework
units.mechanism: 把水位降深、地面高差及處理設備損失合併為總揚程，追蹤電耗與抽水量。 泵功率需包含靜揚程、摩擦和局部損失的總揚程；效率隨運轉點變動。~Combine drawdown, elevation and treatment losses into total head and track energy alongside extracted volume. Pump duty uses total head including static lift, friction and local losses; efficiency varies with operating point.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：水量 Q=0.01 m³/s；總揚程 H=15 m；ρ=1000 kg/m³；g=9.81 m/s²；η=0.65。公式 P=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1000，計算得 2.26385 kW。適用邊界：清水密度與固定效率概念估算，不替代含固體泵選型或防爆設計。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Water flow Q=0.01 m³/s; total head H=15 m; ρ=1000 kg/m³; g=9.81 m/s²; η=0.65. Formula P=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1000 gives 2.26385 kW. Applicability: A water-density, fixed-efficiency estimate, not solids-pump selection or hazardous-area design.
units.verify: 針對「抽水揚程與地上管線」，同時讀取液位、流量、壓力和電力，核對實際工作點。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Pumping head and surface pipework, Read levels, flow, pressure and power together to verify the actual operating point. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 管道堵塞會提高阻力，固定額定功率不代表固定流量。 在「抽水揚程與地上管線」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Pipe blockage raises resistance; a fixed motor rating does not imply fixed flow. Mark where this error can enter the Pumping head and surface pipework flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 馬達額定功率相同的泵在任何管線都提供相同流量。~Pumps with the same motor rating deliver the same flow through any pipe system.
units.practice: 只將 H 改成 20 m，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.26385 變成 3.01846 kW。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only H to 20 m, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 2.26385 to 3.01846 kW. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 水量與污染負荷配對~Pairing water flow with contaminant load
units.mechanism: 用實驗室濃度對齊流量時間窗，地上處理的負荷由質量率決定而非僅看水量。 流量與濃度共同決定質量負荷；mg/L 乘 m³/d 後除以 1000 得 kg/d。~Align laboratory concentrations with flow intervals; surface-treatment duty depends on mass rate rather than volume alone. Flow and concentration jointly determine mass loading; divide mg/L times m³/d by 1000 to obtain kg/d.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：流量 Q=120 m³/d；濃度 C=250 mg/L。公式 load=Q*C/1000，計算得 30 kg/d。適用邊界：流量與樣品代表同一時間窗；單點濃度不能代替流量加權平均。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Flow Q=120 m³/d; concentration C=250 mg/L. Formula load=Q*C/1000 gives 30 kg/d. Applicability: Flow and concentration represent the same time window; a grab value does not replace a flow-weighted mean.
units.verify: 針對「水量與污染負荷配對」，對齊流量計與採樣時間，以分時段 Q×C 加總，核對總量與單位。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Pairing water flow with contaminant load, Align flow-meter and sampling timestamps; sum interval Q×C and check totals and units. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只比較濃度會把稀釋當成污染質量已移除。 在「水量與污染負荷配對」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~A concentration-only comparison can mistake dilution for pollutant removal. Mark where this error can enter the Pairing water flow with contaminant load flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 出流水濃度下降就代表污染總量一定下降。~A lower effluent concentration always means a lower total pollutant load.
units.practice: 只將 Q 改成 150 m³/d，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 30 變成 37.5 kg/d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Q to 150 m³/d, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 30 to 37.5 kg/d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 處理介質與突破預測~Treatment media and breakthrough
units.mechanism: 依污染型態選擇教學吸附流程，計算名目容量並以實際突破曲線校驗。 容量除以污染負荷給名目耗盡時間；傳質、競爭離子及不可逆鈍化通常降低可用容量。~Select a teaching adsorption flow appropriate to the contaminant form and check nominal capacity against breakthrough. Capacity divided by load gives nominal exhaustion time; mass transfer, competition and passivation often lower usable capacity.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：介質質量 m=1000 kg；假設可用容量 a=0.02 kg/kg；污染輸入 L=0.25 kg/d。公式 t=m*a/L，計算得 80 d。適用邊界：固定負荷與已驗證可用容量，不推定真實突破日期。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Media mass m=1000 kg; assumed usable capacity a=0.02 kg/kg; pollutant loading L=0.25 kg/d. Formula t=m*a/L gives 80 d. Applicability: Constant loading and validated usable capacity; no real breakthrough date is implied.
units.verify: 針對「處理介質與突破預測」，做突破曲線並記錄流量、濃度與介質狀態，將可用容量與總化學容量分開。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Treatment media and breakthrough, Measure breakthrough with flow, concentration and media condition; distinguish usable from total chemical capacity. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只用理論反應容量會高估介質壽命。 在「處理介質與突破預測」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Using theoretical reaction capacity alone overestimates media life. Mark where this error can enter the Treatment media and breakthrough flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 介質總質量相同時，不同水質下的使用壽命必定相同。~Equal media mass guarantees equal life in different water chemistry.
units.practice: 只將 L 改成 0.40 kg/d，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 80 變成 50 d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only loading L to 0.40 kg/d, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 80 to 50 d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 孔隙體積與清理拖尾~Pore volumes and cleanup tailing
units.mechanism: 計算抽水孔隙體積數後，仍檢查低滲透區擴散與吸附庫存，不以換水次數代替清理證據。 名目孔隙體積替換時間衡量通量尺度，污染物脫附與低滲透區釋放可持續更久。~After calculating pore volumes, still inspect diffusion from low-permeability zones and sorbed inventory instead of using flushing counts as proof. Nominal pore-volume replacement measures throughput scale; desorption and low-permeability release may persist much longer.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：土體 V=1000 m³；有效孔隙率 ne=0.25；抽出流量 Q=20 m³/d。公式 tPV=V*ne/Q，計算得 12.5 d per nominal pore volume。適用邊界：均勻單一域且 ne 已知；不是整治完成時間。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Bulk volume V=1000 m³; effective porosity ne=0.25; extraction Q=20 m³/d. Formula tPV=V*ne/Q gives 12.5 d per nominal pore volume. Applicability: A homogeneous single domain with known effective porosity, not remediation completion time.
units.verify: 針對「孔隙體積與清理拖尾」，用示蹤、觀測井與抽出濃度比較捕獲範圍和拖尾，不只計算抽了幾倍孔隙水。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Pore volumes and cleanup tailing, Use tracers, monitoring wells and extracted concentrations to assess capture and tailing, not merely pore volumes pumped. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 優先通道可快速換水，但污染仍留在低滲透層。 在「孔隙體積與清理拖尾」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Preferential paths can replace water rapidly while contaminants remain in low-permeability layers. Mark where this error can enter the Pore volumes and cleanup tailing flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 抽完一個孔隙體積就代表所有污染物都被移除。~Pumping one pore volume removes every contaminant.
units.practice: 只將 Q 改成 25 m³/d，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 12.5 變成 10 d per nominal pore volume。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Q to 25 m³/d, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 12.5 to 10 d per nominal pore volume. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 吸附遲滯與殘留源~Sorption retardation and residual sources
units.mechanism: 對比保守示蹤物與污染物的穿透曲線，理解水已更換而污染仍釋出的原因。 線性平衡吸附使溶質平均遷移慢於水；吸附不是污染物破壞。~Compare conservative-tracer and contaminant breakthrough to explain persistent release after water replacement. Linear equilibrium sorption slows mean solute travel relative to water; sorption is not contaminant destruction.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾土體積密度 ρb=1.6 kg/L；Kd=0.5 L/kg；孔隙率 n=0.30。公式 R=1+rho_b*Kd/n，計算得 3.66667 dimensionless。適用邊界：線性、可逆、即時平衡吸附及固定密度孔隙率；不適用強非線性或非平衡拖尾。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry bulk density ρb=1.6 kg/L; Kd=0.5 L/kg; porosity n=0.30. Formula R=1+rho_b*Kd/n gives 3.66667 dimensionless. Applicability: Linear reversible instantaneous equilibrium sorption with fixed density and porosity; not strongly nonlinear or nonequilibrium tailing.
units.verify: 針對「吸附遲滯與殘留源」，用批次與柱試驗檢查 Kd 和濃度依賴性，將吸附物與溶解物總量守恆。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Sorption retardation and residual sources, Check Kd and concentration dependence in batch and column tests and balance sorbed plus dissolved mass. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 把高遲滯因子解讀為已除污會漏掉未來脫附。 在「吸附遲滯與殘留源」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Interpreting high retardation as cleanup overlooks later desorption. Mark where this error can enter the Sorption retardation and residual sources flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 被土壤吸附的污染物已從系統永久消失。~Sorbed contamination has permanently vanished from the system.
units.practice: 只將 Kd 改成 1.0 L/kg，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 3.66667 變成 6.33333 dimensionless。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Kd to 1.0 L/kg, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 3.66667 to 6.33333 dimensionless. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 停泵反彈與捕獲復核~Shutdown rebound and capture review
units.mechanism: 只在離線情境中暫停抽水，觀察濃度回升與水頭重建；同時確認污染是否向外擴張。 停機反彈可能反映低滲透區釋放、脫附或持續源，不等於取樣錯誤。~Pause pumping only in the offline scenario and observe concentration rebound and head recovery while checking outward plume migration. Shutdown rebound may reflect low-permeability release, desorption or a continuing source, not merely sampling error.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：停機前濃度 C1=4 mg/L；重啟濃度 C2=10 mg/L。公式 rebound=C2/C1，計算得 2.5 ratio。適用邊界：同一位置與方法的濃度比；不由此比值直接辨識唯一根因。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Pre-shutdown concentration C1=4 mg/L; restart concentration C2=10 mg/L. Formula rebound=C2/C1 gives 2.5 ratio. Applicability: Concentration ratio at the same location and method; it does not identify a unique cause.
units.verify: 針對「停泵反彈與捕獲復核」，保留停機時間與多次重啟趨勢，對照水位、流量和空白樣。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Shutdown rebound and capture review, Retain shutdown duration and repeated restart trends, comparing heads, flows and blanks. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只報運轉中的低濃度會掩蓋未移除的污染庫存。 在「停泵反彈與捕獲復核」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Reporting low on-treatment values alone hides residual contaminant inventory. Mark where this error can enter the Shutdown rebound and capture review flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 設備運轉時濃度低就證明停機後也永遠保持低濃度。~Low concentration during treatment guarantees permanently low concentration after shutdown.
units.practice: 只將 C2 改成 7 mg/L，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.5 變成 1.75 ratio。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only restart C2 to 7 mg/L, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 2.5 to 1.75 ratio. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 長期策略與量測不確定度~Long-term strategy and uncertainty
units.mechanism: 把流量與濃度的不確定度傳到移除負荷，區分真實減量、測量波動與單純稀釋。 獨立乘積量的相對方差近似相加；有共同校正來源時需加入共變異。~Propagate flow and concentration uncertainty into removal load to distinguish real progress from measurement variation and dilution. Relative variances of independent product quantities approximately add; common calibration sources require covariance.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：獨立相對標準不確定度：流量 uQ=0.04、濃度 uC=0.06。公式 u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²)，計算得 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty。適用邊界：小誤差一階傳播與獨立性假設；標準不確定度不等於 95% 區間。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Independent relative standard uncertainties: flow uQ=0.04, concentration uC=0.06. Formula u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²) gives 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty. Applicability: Small-error first-order propagation and independence; standard uncertainty is not a 95% interval.
units.verify: 針對「長期策略與量測不確定度」，建立每項不確定度來源表，將重複性、校正和代表性分開，檢查相關性。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Long-term strategy and uncertainty, Build an uncertainty budget separating repeatability, calibration and representativeness; inspect correlations. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 增加同偏差的重複測量不能消除系統性誤差。 在「長期策略與量測不確定度」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Repeating measurements with the same bias does not remove systematic error. Mark where this error can enter the Long-term strategy and uncertainty flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 重複量測次數越多，所有系統性誤差都會自動消失。~More repeats automatically eliminate every systematic error.
units.practice: 只將 uC 改成 0.03，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072111 變成 0.05 relative standard uncertainty。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only uC to 0.03, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.072111 to 0.05 relative standard uncertainty. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
